The test `test_review_roles_cannot_run_host_claude` in `tests/test_ai_engine.py` explicitly verifies that RB_JUDGE returns 75 from `claude_run`, confirming this is by design -- but the poller was not given a sandbox alternative. | severity=high | confidence=5
